description: This file defines the class NoteViewHolderWithoutExcerpt, which is a specialized ViewHolder for displaying notes in a list within an Android application. It manages UI components for representing notes without excerpts, handles swipe interactions, and binds note data to UI elements.

classes.name: NoteViewHolderWithoutExcerpt
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for rendering notes without excerpts in a list, managing swipe UI and data binding.

methods.name: NoteViewHolderWithoutExcerpt
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with view binding and a click listener.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Controls the visibility and background color of swipe action indicators based on swipe direction.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to UI components, updates visual states, and handles styling based on note status and search query.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns the view that is swipeable for gesture detection.
